summary: Vendor Analytics Dashboard feature fully tested and working. Backend endpoint GET /api/vendors/analytics/overview returns all required data (summary, sales_trend, top_products, credit_usage, recent_credit_transactions). Frontend Analytics page has 3 tabs (Overview, Products, Credit Analytics) with summary cards, 30-day revenue chart, top products table, and credit transaction history. All previous iteration features (ChatWidget, Marketing Hub, Zomato vendors, Credit system) still working.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test vendor with 1100 credits
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 Vendor Analytics Dashboard fully working. Test vendor has 1100 credits but 0 orders/revenue, so analytics shows empty charts/tables but renders correctly. Credit system operates in MOCKED mode (Razorpay keys not configured). Previous features from iteration 13 all working.

backend.notes: Returns summary, sales_trend (30 days), top_products, credit_usage, recent_credit_transactions

Top Performing Products table with empty state message
Credit Usage by Promotion Type chart, Recent Credit Transactions table with 4 mocked purchases
Total Revenue, Total Orders, Avg Order Value, Promotion ROI, Credit Balance, Credits Spent, Active Promotions, Promoted Revenue

analytics_endpoint_response_structure.top_products: array of objects with product_id, name, revenue, orders, units_sold
